primary.title: CBDT's new crypto reporting guidance explained: What it means for digital asset investors and taxpayers
primary.summary: The CBDT has issued a guidance note to operationalise India's crypto-asset reporting framework in line with the OECD's global standards. While there is no change in crypto taxation, experts say investors should focus on accurate record-keeping as information sharing becomes more structured.
